welcome.title: Beloved, welcome to Evangelical Restoration Church Kimisagara Family
welcome.description1: ERC family is called and dedicated to resiliently raise an army of Disciples of Jesus Christ, who are life givers, fully consecrated to Jesus Christ, coming from different backgrounds, with different history and interconnected by the spirit of family.
welcome.description2: The purpose of our existence is to evangelise, ensure wholisitic restoration through healing and deliverance journey, train, equip and send out transformed people to proclaim the gospel of Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior of individuals, families and Nation(s) to this generation and generations to follow. We love and honour you for you are God's treasured creation, but God loves you most for He paid a price for you to live with Him in eternity. Will you?
welcome.description3: Welcome and a blessed stay or visit at ERC Kimisagara family.
